description: Four channels that each scale and offset a signal, with slice and mix outputs summing them

params.text: Scales that channel's input from -100% to +100%, inverting it below centre and silencing it at centre
Adds a fixed voltage to that channel, -9.5V to +9.5V, although the tooltip reads -10 to 10

inputs.text: The signal that channel scales and offsets

outputs.text: That channel's input scaled and offset, clamped at 10V either way
The positive parts of all four channel outputs added together, clamped at 10V
The negative parts of all four channel outputs added together, clamped at -10V
The channels whose own OUT jack is empty, added together and clamped at 10V either way
All four channel outputs added together, clamped at 10V either way

notes: Channel 2's input takes channel 1's when its own jack is empty, and channel 4's takes channel 3's the same way, so one signal can be fed to a pair of channels from one cable.
